svg.text: Print upside down on the wall tops, with support under the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 1.5 mm thick with the 46 x 24 mm display opening.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Walls 20 mm tall and 2 mm thick on both sides and the head end of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: opening; the tail end is open toward the user.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two clip legs 40 mm long, 2 mm thick, down both sides of the top shell;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a lip on each leg snaps under the rib on the shell side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 68.4 mm across at the legs; legs 0.2 mm clear of the ribs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: press straight down until both lips click under the ribs. To take

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it off, spread the legs with the thumbs and lift.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it does not lift when the scanner is shaken face down.
